declare
temp_drive_sch_date date;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select drive_sch_date
 into temp_drive_sch_date
 from drives_lab
 where drive_id = :drive_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and drive_sch_date between (:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date - 1)
 and (:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date + 1);

 then

 when OTHERS
 then

 check_package_failure;
 end;

 dl.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 dl.group_site_id =

 group_sites.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and

 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception

 then

 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_donor_decision_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_contract VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_result_dats date;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :GLOBAL.unit_form_checkin_flag := 'Y';
 begin
 --
 -- this SQL guarantees that unit_id itself is unique
 -- throughout the system, independent of the chapter
 -- or the collection date. All other places need
 -- coll_date and chapter_id as part of the primary key
 --
 select contract_id
 into temp_contract
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id;
 if temp_contract is not null
 then
 show_error('0180');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :GLOBAL.unit_form_checkin_flag := 'Y';
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.unit_form_checkin_flag := 'N';
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 go_item('s_unit_id');
 clear_item;
 show_error('0160');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from temp_units
 where unit_id = :unit_id;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.unit_tube_checkin_flag := 'N';
 else
 if temp_count = 1
 then
 :GLOBAL.unit_tube_checkin_flag := 'Y';
 else
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 go_item('s_unit_id');
 clear_item;
 show_error('0170');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select nvl(min(result_dats),:coll_date+1)
 into temp_result_dats
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 if trunc(:coll_date) > trunc(temp_result_dats)
 then
 show_error('0094');
 check_package_Failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 end;
end;

declare

begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 if NVL(length(:s_dd), 0) != 7
 then
 show_error('1210');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 if :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C' then
 validate_dd_scan_codabar(:s_dd,temp_dd_code,
 temp_dd_code_desc);
 else
 validate_dd_scan_code128(:s_dd,temp_dd_code,
 temp_dd_code_desc);
 end if;
 :donor_decision_code := temp_dd_code;

 end if;
 :donor_decision_code_desc := temp_dd_code_desc;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: PERFORM_COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_test_seq_no number;
 temp_max_test_seq_no number; 
 cursor c2 is
 select test_id
 from contract_tests
 where contract_id = 'INTERNAL'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 cursor c1 is
 select test_id, test_seq_no,
 test_state, test_mode,
 result_status_1, result_status_2,
 tb_id, test_chapter_id, tb_seq_no,
 well_number, absorbance, ratio, result_dats,
 result_user_id, testing_lab_code, cancel_flag
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 tb_id is not null and
 result_status_1 is not null and
 result_status_2 is null and
 cancel_flag is null
 order by test_id, test_seq_no;
 cursor c3 is
 select test_id, test_seq_no, insert_Dats,
 insert_user_id, program_id
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 tb_id is null
 order by test_id, test_seq_no;
begin
 if :s_dd is null
 then
 :s_dd := 'no_scan';
 end if;
 if :s_dd != '123'
 then
 if :s_dd = 'no_scan'
 then
 :s_dd := '';
 end if;
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 savepoint all_clear;
 if :GLOBAL.unit_form_checkin_flag = 'Y'
 then
 begin
 update units
 set warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 donor_decision_code = :donor_decision_code,
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 coll_date = :coll_date,
 drive_id = :drive_id,
 group_site_id = :group_site_id,
 contract_id = 'INTERNAL',
 program_id = :banner.prog_name,
 chk_digit = substr(:chk_digit,-1) 
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL Consulting */
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
 insert into units
 (unit_id, warehouse_id, chk_digit, coll_date, chapter_id, insert_dats, drive_id,
 group_site_id, donor_decision_code, contract_id,
 received_date, program_id, unit_scheme_type)
 values (:unit_id, :GLOBAL.warehouse, substr(:chk_digit,-1), :coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 sysdate, :drive_id, :group_site_id,
 :donor_decision_code, 'INTERNAL',
 trunc(sysdate), :banner.prog_name, :GLOBAL.code_scheme);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if :GLOBAL.unit_tube_checkin_flag = 'Y'
 then
/* Following update statement was modified on 04/24/95 by SRI
 to include SERUM_PLASMA_IND in the update fields list. This
 change is incorporated since tubes check in function is now
 modified to accept 2 purple tubes
 */
 begin
 update units
 set (red_tube_flag, purple_tube_flag,
 serum_plasma_ind,red_tube2, program_id ) =
 (select red_tube_flag, purple_tube_flag,
 purple_tube2_flag, red_tube2,:banner.prog_name 
 from temp_units
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id)
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating units- 2nd statement');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 delete from temp_units
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in deleting temp_units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'S'
 then
 begin
 insert into unit_attributes
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id,
 attrib_group, attrib_code, status_flag,
 stop_label_flag, insert_dats, insert_user_id,
 program_id)
 select :unit_id, :coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 attrib_group, attrib_code, status_flag,
 stop_label_flag, sysdate, :banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name
 from valid_attributes
 where attrib_group = 'DON' and
 attrib_code = '00' and
 unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme and --HCLC Code128 +
 sysdate between eff_Date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when DUP_VAL_ON_INDEX
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'T'
 then
 begin
 insert into unit_attributes
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id,
 attrib_group, attrib_code, status_flag,
 stop_label_flag, insert_dats, insert_user_id,
 program_id)
 select :unit_id, :coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 attrib_group, attrib_code, status_flag,
 stop_label_flag, sysdate, :banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name
 from valid_attributes
 where attrib_group = 'DON' and
 attrib_code = '14' and
 unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme and --HCLC Code128 +
 sysdate between eff_Date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when DUP_VAL_ON_INDEX
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 --
 -- Interdictions because of bad Cue
 --
 if :donor_decision_code = 'N'
 then
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction (
 :unit_id, :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'SELF',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdictions SELF not assigned to unit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'A'
 then
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction (
 :unit_id, :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'AMBI',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdictions AMBI not assigned to unit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'O'
 then
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction (
 :unit_id, :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'NCP',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdictions NCP not assigned to unit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'T'
 then
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction (
 :unit_id, :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'THER',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdictions THER not assigned to unit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 begin
 --
 -- it is possible that interdictions were created
 -- from test results at a time when the unit was not
 -- checked-in at all. In such cases, the chapter_id and
 -- coll_date are going to be null in unit_interdictions.
 -- This is updated the first unit is checked
 -- in from any source. There is an inherent
 -- bug here as units from different chapters might
 -- actually get the same chapter_id.
 --
 update unit_interdictions
 set chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 coll_date = :coll_date,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 (chapter_id is null or coll_date is null);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating unit interdictions');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 --
 -- it is possible that tests were created in utrs
 -- at a time when the unit was not checked-in at all,
 -- specially for antigens. In such cases, the chapter_id and
 -- coll_date are going to be null in utrs.
 -- This is updated when the first unit is checked
 -- in from any source. There is an inherent
 -- bug here as units from different chapters might
 -- actually get the same chapter_id.
 --
 update utrs
 set chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 coll_date = :coll_date,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 (chapter_id is null or coll_date is null);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in updating utrs - coll_date/chapter_id is null');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 --
 -- it is possible that attributes were created
 -- from test results at a time when the unit was not
 -- checked-in at all. In such cases, the chapter_id and
 -- coll_date are going to be null in unit_attributes.
 -- This is updated the first unit is checked
 -- in from any source. There is an inherent
 -- bug here as units from different chapters might
 -- actually get the same chapter_id.
 --
 update unit_attributes
 set chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 coll_date = :coll_date,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 (chapter_id is null or coll_date is null);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating unit attributes');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 --
 -- it is possible that transactions were created
 -- in unit_test_base when the unit was not
 -- checked-in at all. In such cases, the chapter_id and
 -- coll_date are going to be null in
 -- unit_test_base. This is updated when the first unit
 -- is checked in from any source. There is an inherent
 -- bug here in case of collision between unit_ids from
 -- two different chapters.
 --
 update unit_test_base
 set chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 coll_date = :coll_date,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 (chapter_id is null or coll_date is null);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating unit test base');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- The following block moves transactions from utb to utrs.
 -- It is only done for non-therapeutic donations.
 -- The sequence of utr activity is as follows:
 -- 1. Insert transcations in utr from profile tests
 -- 2. Insert transcations in utr from transactions in utb
 -- which were scheduled from the core routine. and the
 -- test results have still not come. These can be
 -- identified by tb_id being null.
 -- 3. Update results from utb to utrs as present.
 -- 4. Transfer all reconciled tests from UTB to UTR(as left in UTB)
 --
 -- DO NOT CHANGE THIS SEQUENCE WHATEVER HAPPENS !!
 --
 -- Step .1.
 --
 if :donor_decision_code != 'T'
 then
 begin
 for c2_rec in c2
 loop
 begin
 insert into utrs
 (unit_id,coll_date,chapter_id,test_seq_no,test_id,
 insert_dats,insert_user_id,program_id)
 select :unit_id, :coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 nvl(max(test_seq_no),0)+1, c2_rec.test_id,
 sysdate, :banner.user_id, :banner.prog_name
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and test_id = c2_rec.test_id;
 --
 -- check for cancel_flag being nul has been
 -- intentionally removed
 --
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting into utrs - 1');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end loop;
 end;
 --
 -- Step .2.
 --
 begin
 for c3_rec in c3
 loop
 begin
 insert into utrs
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id,
 test_seq_no, test_id, insert_dats, insert_user_id,
 program_id)
 select :unit_id , :coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 nvl(max(test_seq_no),0)+1, c3_rec.test_id,
 c3_rec.insert_dats, c3_rec.insert_user_id,
 c3_rec.program_id
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = c3_rec.test_id;
 --
 -- check for cancel_flag being nul has been
 -- intentionally removed
 --
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in inserting into utrs from utb');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 begin
 delete from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = c3_rec.test_id and
 test_seq_no = c3_rec.test_seq_no;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in deleting from utb - 1');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 end loop;
 end;
 --
 -- Step .3.
 --
 begin
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 begin
 select min(test_seq_no), max(test_seq_no)
 into temp_test_seq_no, temp_max_test_seq_no
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = c1_rec.test_id and

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_COLLECTION_YEAR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- According to code 128 previous month units has to be carried to the next month in accordance 
--with a tolerance value specified at the chapter level.

--This procedure will validate Collection_year as per Code128 format 
PROCEDURE VALIDATE_COLLECTION_YEAR(p_collection_year in varchar2,
 p_coll_date in date)
IS
 temp_validate_yy number(3);
 temp_collection_year_add number(3);
 temp_collection_year_minus number(3);
BEGIN
 --collection year should be numeric 
 IF( LTRIM( p_collection_year,'0123456789') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 show_error('8020');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 --If the collection year and the system year are same then return back 
 IF ( TO_NUMBER(p_collection_year) = TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(sysdate,'yy') ))THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 -- check the label year should be (+,-) of 1 within the collection year.
 temp_collection_year_add :=TO_NUMBER(p_collection_year) +1;
 temp_collection_year_minus := TO_NUMBER(p_collection_year) -1;
 IF( temp_collection_year_add = 100 ) THEN
 temp_collection_year_add :=0;
 ELSIF ( temp_collection_year_minus = -1) THEN
 temp_collection_year_minus := 99;
 END IF;
 IF ((temp_collection_year_add = TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(sysdate,'yy'))) 
 OR ( temp_collection_year_minus=TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(sysdate,'yy'))) ) THEN 
 NULL;
 ELSE
 show_error('9708');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 -- Select the tolerance 
 DECLARE
 temp_v_global_chapter_id varchar2(5) := NAME_IN('global.chapter_id');
 temp_c_interval number(3);
 BEGIN
 SELECT validate_yy_value 
 INTO temp_validate_yy
 FROM chapters
 WHERE chapter_id =temp_v_global_chapter_id
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 365) ;
 IF( temp_validate_yy = -1)
 OR ( temp_validate_yy IS NULL) THEN
 RETURN; -- No validation required
 END IF;
 IF ( TO_NUMBER(p_collection_year) > TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR( SYSDATE,'yy') ) ) THEN 
 IF (( TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR( p_coll_date,'DDD')) ) > temp_validate_yy) THEN
 show_error('9709');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSIF (TO_NUMBER(p_collection_year) < TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(p_coll_date,'yy'))) THEN
 /*
 **calculate acceptable interval last day of the year of p_coll_date minus 
 **Julian day of the year for day of p_coll_date
 */
 temp_c_interval := TO_RRDATE(to_char(p_coll_date,'DD-MON-YY'),'DD-MON-RR') - TO_RRDATE( '31-DEC-'|| p_collection_year,'DD-MON-RR'); 
 IF( temp_c_interval > temp_validate_yy )THEN
 show_error('9709');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 END IF; 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;-- dont validate
 /*WHEN form_trigger_failure THEN
 raise FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;*/
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
EXCEPTION
 when form_trigger_failure then
 raise FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_COLL_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--This procedure validates Collection centers as per Code128 format 

PROCEDURE VALIDATE_COLL_ID( p_coll_id in varchar2)
 IS
 temp_c_coll_id VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_c_chapter_id VARCHAR2(5) :=name_in('Global.chapter_id');
BEGIN
 SELECT distinct coll_id
 INTO temp_c_coll_id 
 FROM valid_collection_agencies
 WHERE coll_id = P_coll_id
 --AND Contract_id = 'INTERNAL'
 AND contract_id = nvl(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.man_contract_id,contract_id)
 AND chapter_id = temp_c_chapter_id
 AND sysdate between eff_date 
 AND NVL(term_date, sysdate + 365);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 show_error('9712');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
END;
